song.name: The Unending War
song.plot: The war against the Legion drags on — no victory in sight, ground lost, the planes bleeding. The survivors and the resistance hold day after day against an endless tide. The grinding middle of the invasion.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: the survivors / resistance ("we"), a war chronicle of the grinding middle. Anchors: the Legion of Souls, Nythoria, the war without end, the fading light, the planes, the resistance's dwindling hope. Names The Shadow-Vale as a battleground (DB-verified Location); keeps the Black Well out of the core war imagery as it is Acheron's discarded-Tome site (Era I). No Vorgos acting (he only watches), no Anya, no Rift, no victory. Structure: Verse → Chorus → Verse → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus. Driving, relentless. Suggested Suno direction: relentless war anthem — fast drums, aggressive guitars, exhausted-but-fighting vocals.

section.name: Verse
section.reworked: [Intro: distant war drums, cold wind] [Verse 1: weary, steady drums] Day after day beneath the faded sun, The Legion comes, and still we hold the line. At the Shadow-Vale the battle is won, Then lost again, and we go on.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: [Chorus: relentless, double-kick drums, aggressive] This is the war that never ends, We trade our blood for borrowed days. Nythoria's light is growing dim, But we will not surrender it.

section.name: Verse
section.reworked: [Verse 2: exhausted vocals, chugging guitars] The planes are bleeding, one by one, The resistance holds with fading breath. No victory in sight, no rising sun, Only the dark, and us beneath.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: [Chorus: relentless, double-kick drums, aggressive] This is the war that never ends, We trade our blood for borrowed days. Nythoria's light is growing dim, But we will not surrender it.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: [Bridge: stripped, lone voice, near-whisper] Hold the ground, though hope has fled, Hold the ground, for the living dead. Somewhere a watcher weighs the cost, And we are the ones the lines are lost.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: [Chorus: massive, exhausted roar, drums fade] This is the war that never ends, We trade our blood for borrowed days. Nythoria's light is growing dim, But we will not surrender it.
